founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Rohan is the Founder and CEO of Serafis. He was formerly the Head of Data at Ribbit Capital ($12B AUM). Prior to that, he was a Software Engineer at Google, then bootstrapped and exited Kosmos — a data integrations SaaS for wealth managers. He studied Computer Science at Princeton University.

launches.title: Serafis - the podcast app for investors
launches.tagline: Narrative intelligence to help you find the next 10x idea
launches.body:
**TL;DR** Serafis helps you discover ideas worth paying attention to, from the voices that matter. Our data platform is already used by top asset managers and the world's largest consulting firms. Now, narrative intelligence fits in your pocket.

> “Anytime somebody from one of the \[AI\] labs goes on a podcast … it’s so important to listen … it’s in my job description. There are some real needles in the haystack.”
>
> Gavin Baker, CIO of Atreides Management ($5B AUM)

🎥 [Discover the next 10x idea with Serafis.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=979mS9_-Bs4)

**Serafis indexes the information frontier**

The sharpest minds now go direct. CEOs, founders, researchers and investors increasingly share their perspectives on independent channels. Hearing from credible voices is one of the most effective ways to:

* Generate new investment ideas
* Research markets and companies
* Develop your view on any given topic

**The problem:** harnessing this information is a challenge. It’s scattered and buried across thousands of hours of audio.

Serafis is building a structured, queryable knowledge graph for narratives – starting with podcasts. Search by person, company or theme across 100K+ curated transcripts.

**We’re democratizing narrative intelligence**

Today we’re launching the [Serafis mobile app](https://serafis.app): the world’s first podcast app for investors, with an AI-native interface.

* Discover content relevant to the companies you follow
* Explore a feed of the most insightful ideas found in podcasts
* Ask questions about episodes, shows, or the Serafis library. Get answers with timestamped citations that take you to the exact quote.

We’ve thoughtfully integrated AI to help you find better information, faster. We also know how important it is to stay close to the source. For any episode, you can export, search, and highlight the full transcript.

**Download the app now:**

* [**iOS**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/serafis/id6751523936)
* [**Android**](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.r9a.serafis.mobileui)

We’d love your feedback. Feel free to get in touch: [founders@serafis.ai](mailto:founders@serafis.ai)

If you’re a business interested in using our data platform, please [request a demo.](https://tally.so/r/gD0xxK)
